options.description: The HLR options every footprint's projection used.

runtime.description: The Geometer runtime the projection used.

footprints.description:
Every footprint that names a 3D model, sorted by `documentPath`, then
`uuid`, each in code point order; a footprint with no model at all is not
listed. Footprints with a resolvable STEP model carry `pose`, `outline` and
`detail`; the others carry a `status`.

description:
The HLR projection of every footprint that names a 3D model, the bundle
member `models/assembly-hlr.json` (stage `models`).
title: Prism assembly HLR a0

projectionAlgorithm.description: The projection algorithm, when the config set one. Absent when Geometer's default applies.

samplesPerCurve.description: How many segments one curve samples into when `curveMode` is `polyline`.

roundDigits.description: Decimal digits retained in the projected geometry.

meshLinearDeflection.description: Mesh linear deflection in millimetres, when set. Absent when Geometer's default applies.

meshAngularDeflection.description: Mesh angular deflection in radians, when set. Absent when Geometer's default applies.

meshRelative.description: Whether the mesh deflections are relative to the model size, when set. Absent when Geometer's default applies.

hlrAngleTolerance.description: The hidden-line-removal angle tolerance in degrees, when set. Absent when Geometer's default applies.

edgeFlags.description:
The per-edge-family visibility flags passed to Geometer. The keys are
Geometer's flag names (for example `edge_v_outline`), serialized in code
point order. Absent when no flags were set.

AssemblyHlrOptions.description:
The HLR options every footprint's projection used. The values are the
options passed to Geometer, so a consumer can reproduce the projection from
the model bytes. The projection's side is not here: it is each footprint's
own `side`.

geometerVersion.description:
The Geometer runtime's version string, exactly as `geometer.version()`
reports it, for example `2026.9.7`. It is part of the generator id's
`hlr_procedure`.

AssemblyHlrRuntime.description: The Geometer runtime the projection used.

reference.description: The footprint's reference designator, as written. Absent when it has none or it is empty.

side.description: The footprint's side: `back` when its `(layer …)` starts with `B.`.

stepModel.description: The footprint's first STEP model. Absent when it names no `.step`/`.stp` model (`model-not-step`).

pose.description: The model's pose. Present exactly when the model was projected (`outline` and `detail` are present).

outline.description: The silhouette edges, board frame. Present exactly when the projection succeeded.

detail.description: The visible-internal edges, board frame. Present exactly when the projection succeeded.

status.description:
Why the footprint has no geometry. Present exactly when `outline` and
`detail` are absent; absent when the projection succeeded.

AssemblyHlrFootprint.description: One footprint's model, pose and projected geometry, or the reason it has none.

AssemblyHlrProjectionAlgorithm.description: The projection algorithm: Geometer's `projection_algorithm` token, kept verbatim.

AssemblyHlrOutlineAlgorithm.description: The outline (silhouette) algorithm: Geometer's `outline_algorithm` token, kept verbatim.

AssemblyHlrCurveMode.description: A footprint's projection curve output mode: Geometer's `curve_mode` token, kept verbatim.

Count.description: A count of things: a non-negative safe integer.

RepoPath.description:
Repository-relative POSIX path, exactly as `git ls-tree` names the entry:
`/`-separated, case preserved, no leading `/`, no empty, `.` or `..`
segment, no backslash and no `:`. The same character rule as ArchivePath.
It is the only path type in bundle documents: a file has one spelling
whichever project in the repository refers to it, and a file outside the
project directory needs no `..`.

KiCadUuid.description:
KiCad object UUID in the canonical form KiCad writes (`KIID::AsString`):
lowercase hexadecimal, 8-4-4-4-12. Copied from the file, never generated
or re-cased.

Refdes.description:
Reference designator as KiCad resolves it for one symbol instance or
footprint, for example `R1`, `U3`, `#PWR01` or `R?`. Always a string. A
contract states whether it includes virtual (`#`) and unannotated (`?`)
references.

Side.description: Board side of a footprint, pad or graphic.

reference.description:
The model reference as written in the footprint's `(model …)`: a
`${VAR}`-relative path, a repository-relative path, or a `kicad-embed://`
reference.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the STEP file's bytes. Absent when the bytes could not be resolved (`model-unavailable`).

AssemblyHlrModel.description: The footprint's first STEP model and the digest of its bytes.

positionNm.description: Board-absolute anchor of the footprint: its `(at x y)` in KiCad's board frame.

rotationDeg.description: The footprint's orientation in degrees, as written, not normalized.

modelOffset.description: The model's `(offset x y z)` as written, in nanometres.

modelRotation.description: The model's `(rotate x y z)` as written, in degrees.

modelScale.description: The model's `(scale x y z)` as written.

AssemblyHlrPose.description:
The pose of the footprint's model: the footprint's placement on the board,
plus the model's own offset, rotation and scale, exactly the inputs of
Cruncher's `kicad_model_local_pose`.

segments.description:
The straight edges, in the order Geometer returned them after Cruncher's
deduplication (endpoints ordered and duplicates removed).

arcs.description: The circular edges, in the order Geometer returned them after Cruncher's deduplication.

AssemblyHlrEdges.description: A projected edge set: its segments and arcs.

AssemblyHlrStatus.description: Why a footprint's body was not projected.

Sha256Hex.description: Lowercase hexadecimal SHA-256 digest: exactly 64 characters, no prefix such as `sha256:`.

xNm.description: X coordinate in nanometres, +x to the right.

PointNm.description:
A point in nanometres in KiCad's board frame: +x to the right, +y down, as
in the file and never flipped. The field holding the point states whether
it is board-absolute or footprint-local. For camelCase (projection)
documents only.

Degrees.description:
Angle in degrees. In new documents it is as written in the KiCad file:
not normalized, not rounded. A parity document may round it as today's
output does, and its field says so. A positive angle is a counter-clockwise rotation as KiCad shows
it on the front side. Each field states the frame its angle is in.

xDeg.description: Rotation about x, in degrees as written.

yDeg.description: Rotation about y, in degrees as written.

zDeg.description: Rotation about z, in degrees as written.

startNm.description: The edge's start point, board frame.

endNm.description: The edge's end point, board frame.

AssemblyHlrSegment.description: One straight edge of a projected edge set.

startNm.description: The arc's start point, board frame.

endNm.description: The arc's end point, board frame.

centerNm.description: The arc's center point, board frame.

extentDeg.description: The arc's angular extent in degrees, from Geometer's `extent_rad`.

ccw.description: True when the arc runs counter-clockwise from `startNm` to `endNm`.

fullCircle.description: True when the arc is a full circle, in which case `startNm` and `endNm` coincide.

AssemblyHlrArc.description: One circular edge of a projected edge set, the fields Geometer returns.

Nanometres.description:
Length or coordinate in integer nanometres, KiCad's internal board unit.
Converted from the file's decimal millimetres as KiCad's own parser does:
the double product value_mm * 1e6, rounded half away from zero. A single
coordinate or dimension fits KiCad's 32-bit range; sums (for example a
net's total track length) may not, hence a safe integer (|n| < 2^53).

NonNegativeNanometres.description: A Nanometres value that is never negative: a thickness, width, diameter or length.
